title: picea glauca subsp. albertiana
intro: Picea glauca subsp. albertiana, commonly known as White Spruce, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree that belongs to the Pinaceae family. The White Spruce has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Picea glauca subsp. albertiana include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
